meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a great pair of running shoes under ₹3,000 in India requires balancing durability, cushioning, and brand reliability. While entry-level models from global performance brands often retail higher, frequent online sales (on Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, and brand websites) regularly drop them into this budget.

The top running shoes and brands to look out for under ₹3,000 include:

### 1. Adidas (Duramo Series / Entry Performance)

* **Models to look for:** Adidas Duramo SL, Adidas Rayrun, or various entry-level response shoes.[www.youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ahw9wVUnrMc#:~:text=best%20running%20shoes%20under%203000%2C%20running%20shoes,%23adidas%20%23PUMA%20%23YOHO%20%23RunWithBala%20%23Running%20%23ShoeReview%20%23Fitness.)
* **Why buy:** Adidas budget running shoes offer great build quality and decent underfoot cushioning. They use durable rubber outsoles that withstand Indian road conditions much better than generic fashion brands.
* **Price Range:** Often discounted to **₹2,200 – ₹2,999** during sales.

### 2. Campus

* **Models to look for:** Campus Oxyfit, Camp-First, or their running-specific mesh lines.
* **Why buy:** Campus is an Indian brand that dominates the budget segment. They provide surprisingly plush cushioning, highly breathable mesh uppers, and great initial step-in comfort for casual runners and walkers.
* **Price Range:** **₹1,200 – ₹2,200** (Great value for money).

### 3. Decathlon (Kalenji / Kiprun)

* **Models to look for:** Kalenji **Jogflow 190.1** or **Jogflow 500.1** (when on discount).[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/men-running-shoes-25402#:~:text=Kalenji%20Men%20Running%20Shoes%20Superior%20Grip%20Cushioned,MRP%20%E2%82%B925%2C999.%20Gender%20Category%20Size.%20Men%20Women.)
* **Why buy:** Decathlon is unmatched for transparency and practical durability. The Jogflow series is specifically designed for beginner road runners (up to 10–20 km a week), offering reliable shock absorption and solid grip.[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Kalenji%20MEN'S%20RUNNING%20SHOES%20JOGFLOW%20100.1%20GREY,-%20Light%20yellow.%2046.%20%E2%82%B919%2C999.%20MRP%20%E2%82%B925%2C999.)
* **Price Range:** **₹1,500 – ₹2,999**.[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Kalenji%20Men%20Running%20Shoes%20Superior%20Grip%20Cushioned,Gender%20Category%20Size.%20Men%20Women%20Girls%20Boys.)

### 4. Puma

* **Models to look for:** Puma Electrify or entry-level Axis/Scuderia variants.[www.mensxp.com](https://www.mensxp.com/fashion/shoes/47756-these-are-the-best-running-shoes-under-rs-3000-for-men-who-are-all-for-fitness.html#:~:text=This%20pair%20of%20white%20running%20shoes%20by,MRP%3A%20Rs.%202%2C049.%20BUY%20IT%20HERE.%202.)
* **Why buy:** Puma offers great styling paired with soft foam sock-liners.[www.mensxp.com](https://www.mensxp.com/fashion/shoes/47756-these-are-the-best-running-shoes-under-rs-3000-for-men-who-are-all-for-fitness.html#:~:text=This%20pair%20of%20white%20running%20shoes%20by,MRP%3A%20Rs.%202%2C049.%20BUY%20IT%20HERE.%202.) They work well for light jogging, gym workouts, and casual daily wear.
* **Price Range:** Frequently drops to **₹2,000 – ₹2,999** on Myntra and Amazon.

---

### Quick Buying Tips:

* **For Daily Running / Jogging:** Prioritize **Decathlon (Kalenji)** or **Adidas** for better impact protection and foam longevity.
* **For Walking & Gym / Casual Use:** **Campus** or **Puma** offer great aesthetics and immediate comfort.
* **Check the Sole:** Ensure the outsole has rubber patches rather than just exposed foam, as exposed foam wears down very quickly on rough Indian tarmac.

What is your primary use case (e.g., daily running, gym workouts, or casual walking)?
